gates.gram_convergence: Every seed and pooled median must have lower Frobenius error at largest N than smallest N; intermediate lengths are diagnostic, not required monotone.
gates.pole_policy: All finite near-pole residuals use the same 1e-12 gate and are reported separately. Exact x=0 is undefined for even K and must be flagged, not treated as success.
gates.finite: All IID samples and images must be finite; retain failures and fail the gate if any.

hypothesis: Under standard Cauchy measure, Cayley power modes are orthonormal and composition with H_K maps index k to K*k. This is a coordinate identity, not input compression or a diagonal eigenfunction relation.
sampling: PCG64(seed), theta=pi*U with U in (0,1), x=cot(theta); no iterative orbit, burn-in or float32. Reject unexpected RNG endpoint; do not reseed.
negative_control: Use input gamma_star(alpha)*x, actual Boole F_alpha and Cayley scale gamma_star(alpha). Test the K=2 shift identity; alpha=0.5 is positive, 0.25 and 0.75 must fail despite standardized invariant measure.
scope: E0B only. E0A float32 failure is retained; no synchronization, compression, decoder or TM superiority claim.
